Subject: English. Chapter: Reading comprehension.

Selected topic: Detect an unanswerable passage-question mismatch. Task type: Applied practice.

Specific task: Construct a short passage with one question requiring absent information. Demonstrate an explicit insufficient-evidence response and explain why outside knowledge cannot repair a passage-based question, as with the supplied 2021 mismatch.

Stay within this selected topic. Teach the explanation directly; do not return only a reading list or source links.

Check whether any current affairs are directly related to this selected topic and include explained notes on relevant developments, why they matter and their connection to the static concept or exam task. Do this even for a static or applied-practice topic. If no relevant development is found in the sources checked, say so without inventing a connection; if you cannot check, state that limitation rather than claiming there are no updates. For English, keep external current-affairs evidence separate from passage-based answers.

Where useful, include a mind map, infographic, flowchart or comparison/data table to improve understanding and memorisation. Choose formats suited to the topic rather than forcing every format. Provide the actual visual or table content, not just a suggestion to create it; if image rendering is unavailable, use a readable text mind map, labelled flowchart or Markdown table. Use concise labels and retrieval cues, preserve important qualifications, and label units, dates and sources for factual data; do not invent statistics for a visual.

Give the requested original passage/draft/outline or model response, explicit workings such as word counts where required, and a fully revealed explanation. Do not reproduce protected source passages. Separate passage-based answers from outside facts. Use a diagnostic checklist, not an invented official RBI score or rubric.

State the as-of date you can actually verify. Use primary RBI/SEBI/Ministry/MoSPI/official publisher sources as applicable; give document title, edition/reference period, release/effective date and source URL. Separate historical rule, announcement/proposal, operative rule and verified current status. If browsing or necessary source pages are unavailable, explicitly mark missing facts unverified and request the relevant document; never invent a latest edition, limit, rank, scheme availability or legal provision. Do not assume a 2027 rule is already known.

When supplied, check relevant material in all four preparation collections: CurrentAffairs-Monthly, Reports_NationalAndInternational, SchemesAndGovernmentPortals and StaticGK. Reconcile related evidence across them, then verify factual claims against primary sources. Explicitly identify unavailable collections; do not claim to have scanned files you cannot access.

Use clearly labelled invented numbers/people for examples. Cite reliable sources for factual or theoretical attributions and distinguish established definitions from debated interpretation. If using any current rule or statistic, state its verified date/source or mark it unverified.

If supplied notes conflict, identify the exact conflict and retain the uncertainty rather than silently selecting a value. End with five short recall questions and fully revealed answers.
